title: Removal of genomic DNA from RNA preparations
author: Maximilian Dietsch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ze2f3ge
materials: go to step #8 go to step #9

steps.title: Prepare DNase I Reaction
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents in an RNase-free tube to a total volume of 10 µl:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl of 10X reaction buffer with MgCl2
Add 1 µl (1U) of RNase-free DNase I
Add water to reach a final volume of 10 µl

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Extract
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction and perform phase separation using EDTA, water, and PCI (phenol chloroform isoamyl alcohol), then vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Centrifuge for Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm and 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the RNA from the aqueous phase and precipitate it.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper phase into a fresh tube
Add 3 volumes of EtOH/3M Natrumacetat (30:1, pH 5.2)

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 30 minutes at 13,000 rpm and 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet without resuspending it.

steps.title: Centrifuge Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample for 10 minutes at 13,000 rpm and 4 °C.

steps.title: Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and allow the pellet to dry for 10 - 15 minutes.
